definitions.pf: Literal p or f anywhere in a study word, including cph/cfh.
definitions.opener: First word of a line whose recorded paragraph-first flag is true.
definitions.removal: Delete selected tokens, keep all remaining words in order, recompute MATTR100.
definitions.allocation: Exact Shapley allocation across four disjoint sets: PF opener, non-PF opener, other PF on selected line, other non-PF on selected line; average over all 24 removal orders.
definitions.fixed_windows: Each distinct spelling contributes 1/100 in its original window; divide its credit equally among its occurrences.
definitions.rolling: End-of-line minus pre-line trailing MATTR100; each arrival gets its new-spelling gain minus the spelling loss from its departing token.
definitions.groups: Same Path 1 Golf groups as the published report; 3c/4a include some pages outside physical Stars/Bio. Physical-only sensitivity reported separately.
